summary: Completed backend + frontend validation for /ai-consulting real submit flow, admin AI Consulting Enquiry surfaces, exports, redirect/removal behavior, responsive checks, and protected hash regression.

ui_bugs.issue: Pressing Enter on Step 1 (Your Details) submits the form and moves to Project Details. Requirement says Enter should submit only on Review step.

action_items: Block Enter-key submit behavior on non-review wizard steps (/ai-consulting).
Re-test wizard keyboard behavior after fix (Step 1/2 Enter should not navigate or submit).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 2300+ lines; split into focused modules (security, public forms, admin APIs, export handlers) to reduce regression risk.
Current AI consulting submission logic (frontend + backend) correctly prevents duplicate POST on rapid double-click via sending latch and disabled state.
CSV exports correctly include wizard fields and apply formula-escape for user-entered values.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary QA records with qa.aic29.* emails for backend/frontend checks; cleaned test records from contact_enquiries and project_enquiries after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key artifacts: /app/test_reports/screenshots_iter29/ai_consulting_success_desktop_1920x800.jpeg, ai_consulting_success_mobile_390x844.jpeg, admin_desktop_list_modal_1920x800.jpeg, admin_mobile_menu_390x844.jpeg, admin_mobile_list_390x844.jpeg, admin_mobile_modal_390x844.jpeg. Protected hash check passed via /tmp/ai-consulting-submit-protected-before.sha256. Verified old /admin/project-enquiries redirects to /admin/get-in-touch and old menu label is absent. Verified frontend error-state handling for 422/409/429/500/network via route interception.
rca of the issue: RCA for Enter-key bug: the form-level onSubmit handler (state.next) is active for all steps, so pressing Enter in Step 1 inputs triggers normal submit behavior and advances step when current inputs are valid. Mitigation: intercept Enter key for non-review steps (or make non-review actions explicit button-only) while retaining Enter submit on Review step.
